conf.description: F5 BIG-IP LTM configuration audit log (syslog-raw MCP/tmsh + httpd auth records), direct route: header + AUDIT-marker kv-style parse handling the two record shapes (mcpd 01420002 config, httpd 01070417 auth) separately, event.outcome from bracketed status, event.action verb lift from cmd_data, cmd_data length-capped. No masking regex implemented - see README gap. Keep _raw.

conf.comment: F5 BIG-IP LTM audit log, syslog-raw, direct route. No Elastic integration covers this feed. Two record shapes share the AUDIT marker but not the key set: mcpd 01420002 (pid/user/folder/module/status/cmd_data) and httpd 01070417 (user/partition/level/tty/host/attempts/start). cmd_data and start are each the last key in their shape and are captured to end-of-line so embedded spaces in the verbatim command / quoted date survive; module's documented space-containing values (Configuration Utility, iControl REST) are matched via a small enumerated alternation and any other worded value will truncate at the first space. cmd_data is length-capped (2048 chars) as a cheap safety net, but per the brief's rule against inventing an undocumented algorithm, NO masking regex is applied - the recommendation names cmd_data as a secrets risk but gives no concrete pattern, so full redaction is a documented gap, not implemented.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose, the two-shape split, and the masking gap
Generic syslog header + AUDIT marker parse: timestamp, hostname, daemon, hex message id, and the key=value tail
mcpd configuration/tmsh audit shape: pid, user, folder, module, bracketed status, verbatim cmd_data (captured to end-of-tail)
httpd administrative authentication shape: user, partition, level, tty, host, attempts, start (captured to end-of-tail)

Lift the leading verb into event.action, derive event.outcome/error.message from the bracketed status, wrap level into user.roles, and length-cap cmd_data - all BEFORE rename, reading the flat vendor field names in evaluation order
Batch rename of every mapped/custom (no-transform) field; status/level excluded (already consumed above)
Set event.start from the httpd shape's session-start string (no timezone carried - device timezone assumption is unverified, per the work order's own caution)
Set _time from the syslog header timestamp (no year/timezone in RFC 3164 - best-effort detection, not a verified conversion)
Tag event.dataset; drop now-consumed header/tail scratch. _raw is deliberately kept.
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
